rationale: The full-history scan walks every line ever introduced. Some paths are synthetic by construction (seeded corpora, detector control suites) or are documentation/evidence that quotes placeholder values. Hits there are demoted from the push-blocking count but are still counted, listed and written to the report under syntheticScope. Nothing is dropped. 'test-fixture' entries demote every category because the file IS the detector's control suite; 'declared' entries still keep neverDemotedCategories hard.
